title: Go image/png
notes: png.Decode returns an *image.NRGBA for 8-bit RGBA files, and its Pix slice is returned without a copy. Go checks each chunk's CRC and the zlib Adler-32. File bytes are made from hex outside timing.
details: png.Decode returns an *image.NRGBA for 8-bit RGBA files; its Pix slice is returned as the pixel buffer without a copy. Go checks each chunk's CRC and the zlib stream's Adler-32. The file's bytes are made from hex once per fixture, outside the timed call.
